title: An instance can be changed without leaving the family
goal: A copy is only useful if you can adjust it. The original chooses which parts are adjustable, and every copy can set those without breaking the link back. There are three kinds of knob: wording, whether a part shows at all, and a choice among shapes the original already contains. A copy can also be detached, which turns it into ordinary layers that no longer follow the original.
notes: Step C6 of docs/design/ui-building.md, the last rung before the library is worth shipping. The three property kinds and the no-drift rule come from component-configure-wt.html. States, composites and data binding are explicitly out of scope here (see the deferred list in the spec).
acceptance: On an original, a control adds a property of one of three kinds: text, show or hide, and a choice among existing shapes
An instance inspector shows only those knobs, and changing one changes that instance alone
An edit to the original still reaches an instance that has overridden something else
A choice can only pick shapes the original contains, so an instance can never show something the original does not define
Detach turns an instance into ordinary layers and it stops following the original
Core logic is covered by tests in PhotonzCore written before the implementation
Audit written under queue/audits/, anything rough filed as a follow-up
